findings.title: Rounds module docstring says rerun "re-launches" dead lanes; it only prints the call
locations: src/CLI/Rounds.jl:686-717: `rerun` docstring says "prints the call to the instrument's Workflow ... restricted to the lanes the last bank could not evaluate", and the body only writes args and `println`s `Preflight.workflow_call(...)` — it never invokes the Workflow itself
findings.description: The `Rounds` module docstring's one-liner for `rerun` says it "re-launches dead lanes", but `rerun`'s own docstring and body only regenerate the saved args and print the exact Workflow call for the session to launch by hand; the function performs no launch. The function's own docstring is accurate — only the module-level map overstates it.
findings.resolution_hint: Reword the module docstring's `rerun` bullet to something like "prints the relaunch call for dead lanes" so the map agrees with the function's own docstring.
